snippet.title: Only 3 people will win this mobile game... 🏆 #shorts
snippet.description:
Sure, you could play a nice, relaxing puzzle game... 
Or you could try landing a rocketship from outer space!🚀

Welcome to TouchDown, the first title in the BittyBytes series by Two Skys.
BittyBytes are hard, short, mobile-first action games built to test your limits.
Pilot your rocketship through six brutal zones from outer space to the landing pad!

🏆 REAL-WORLD TROPHY COMPETITION:
We are rewarding the first three players worldwide to finish the game with handcrafted Gold, Silver, and Bronze trophies! 

HOW TO ENTER:
1️⃣ Sign up on our website: https://www.twoskys.com
2️⃣ Once we hit 10k sign-ups, a 20-day launch countdown begins.
3️⃣ When it goes live on iOS & Android, the race for the top three is on!

#shorts #indiedev #mobilegaming #gamedev #hardcoregaming #twoskys
